title: The Banquet of Stone Guests
description: Once a year, the city's gargoyles climb down for lunch. A child on a stool offers the first pomegranate to a guest whose pedestal is still warm.
alt: A child on a stool offers a pomegranate to a winged stone gargoyle. Two more statues sit at the rooftop table beside an empty pedestal.
pairing: A rooftop feast day × gargoyles that leave their pedestals
